rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-3 PIVOT after gamma-inert diagnosis. iter-1(g=1.0) and iter-2(g=0.5) gave BIT-IDENTICAL hr=0.13349368501203374/ssim=0.9267/psnr=35.32 to 17 digits. Slurm logs (769099/769168) PROVE gamma reached the recon: W differs (min 0.0001 vs 0.0107, max 3.131 vs 2.367) and data_term differs (0.01696 vs 0.04011). NOT a key-mismatch, NOT unwired. Root cause: data term is ~1000x smaller than the TV term at tv_lambda=0.001 (data~0.04 vs lam*TV~40.7), so BOTH runs converge to the SAME TV-dominated minimum (identical TV trace 114658->40672) and the gamma ray-weight has ZERO measurable effect on the metric. The PWLS variant at hr 0.1335 sits BELOW plain-TVs hr=0.2085 (search-20260619-01) at identical protocol. Pivoting to a confirmed-wired lever: tv_clip_max 0.05->0.08, the historical plain-TV peak setting, to recover/beat that. ONE knob; all else = iter-1 baseline (gamma=1.0 default, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01)., tv_clip_max=0.08
